patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff failed to apply in the ARVO workspace because it also updates the amalgamated `mongoose.c`, but the authoritative `n132/arvo:58319-fix` image compiled with the same frozen instrumentation guards the protected fourth-byte read for the original 7-byte witness and reaches that same fourth-byte read genuinely on the adjacent 8-byte boundary case `30 06 00 00 ff ff ff 7f`.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: the properties-length varint at p terminates within end - p bytes
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `mg_mqtt_parse()` allows the MQTT v5 properties-length decode to reach a fourth byte, the varint beginning at `p` must already terminate within the caller's remaining suffix `end - p`.
root_cause_criterion.description: For the crashing 7-byte witness, only three bytes remain after the topic, yet the vulnerable parser still permits a fourth-byte properties-length read. The fixed parser enforces the missing length-aware conjunct by rejecting a truncated decode before that fourth read can execute.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original violates the required predicate at properties_varint_guard (`validated_varint_len=0`) while the protected fourth-byte read executes. The fixed original is guarded (`validated_varint_len=0`, no fourth-byte read), and the adjacent 8-byte boundary case `30 06 00 00 ff ff ff 7f` supplies the genuine witness (`validated_varint_len=4`, fourth-byte read executed cleanly).

nodes.state: At the crashing fourth-byte read, `offset` is already equal to the caller's remaining suffix length `end - p`, so the vulnerable `p[offset]` dereference is one byte past the available properties-length bytes.

edges.relation: The same publish-suffix cursor `p` passed at the MQTT v5 properties decode call site becomes the base pointer that `decode_variable_length()` indexes for the protected fourth-byte read.
The caller's remaining properties suffix length `end - p` is the same bound that makes the fourth helper index invalid when `offset` reaches 3 on the crashing 7-byte witness.
